name: Crowncrusher Bulwark

items.name: Statuary Aura
items.text:
20 feet.

Rocks of marble magically arise from the ground in the aura. They protect the bulwark's allies, giving each of them standard Cover. These stones can be used for Throw Rock.

This aura automatically activates at the start of the stone bulwark's first turn in combat and deactivates at the end of combat.

items.name: Binding Stone
items.text: Any creature hit by the stone bulwark's fist or rock Strike is affected by a DC 30 Fortitude save Earthbind spell.

items.name: Inexorable March
items.text: The stone bulwark Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a DC 34 Fortitude save save. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise it is damaged as if hit by the construct's fist.

text: Stone bulwarks are slow and steady constructs typically carved from marble or granite. They're often made to serve as works of art when at rest, so some magical crafters employ master sculptors to ensure their constructs make beautiful statues. Older stone bulwarks might be weathered, with scuffed or cracked surfaces or missing noses and digits, but this weathering is largely cosmetic and doesn't adversely impact the bulwark's functionality.
